summary: Above 1,750 m, intense UV radiation (F14, D23) filters out most visible light and threatens cellular DNA. This crustose lichen spreads across wind-scoured basalt, using melanoidin screens to shield its chlorobiont layer while capturing wind-blown volcanic aerosols (F7, F23). It forms the primary photosynthetic anchor in the alpine zone, feeding specialized scrapers and decomposers, and shares the high-altitude mineral niche with chemosynthetic crusts (D22) but relies on photon capture instead.

links: Altitude exceeds 1,750 m where atmospheric filtering drops to 0.6× sea-level UV (F14, D20)
Melanoidin pigments accumulate in the upper cortex to absorb and scatter ionizing radiation
Photosynthetic layer is shielded but light-starved, restricting growth to wind-sheltered rock fissures
chains.play: Scrape for UV paste: grants temporary photoprotection during midday highland exploration
chains.weakness: Ingesting raw crust causes nausea and blocks low-light photosynthesis if applied to eyes
observe: Pale green tissue exposed only when cracked

plausibility.summary: Crustose, melanised lichen on alpine basalt as primary producer matches F14/D23 high-UV alpine niche and F7/F23 aerosol deposition. Mineral veins and scraper specialists (sosa, babosa) fit F23 lick ecology.
fixes: Correct the UV chain: at ~1,750–2,050 m surface UV is ~1.4× sea level (F14), not reduced. Melanoidin/cortical pigments shield against excess UV while a thin green algal layer photosynthesises in fissures. “Melanoidin toxicity” is weak—rely on arsenic/copper from aerosols (F23) for grazer deterrence.

analogues.organism: Antarctic cryptoendolithic and alpine umbilicate lichens
analogues.mechanism: Dark fungal pigments and mineral crusts reduce UV damage to the photobiont layer (Friedmann, 1982; Büdel et al., 2008, from memory, unverified). Lichens accumulate airborne metals without roots.

chains.trait: Calcite and heavy-metal accumulation in thallus
links: Cold upwelling fog and wind-blown volcanic aerosols deposit dissolved minerals on exposed basalt (F8, F7)
Lichen absorbs these aerosols through surface moisture films without roots
Minerals precipitate into the thallus, creating a concentrated nutrient matrix
Forms a fixed, high-value resource patch in an otherwise barren alpine zone
chains.play: Mine for lick dust: restores salt balance for herds, or use to mark trails and reduce predation risk
chains.weakness: Concentrates arsenic and copper; raw consumption causes vomiting in non-specialists
observe: Yellow mineral veins cross the black surface
Grazers pause here to scrape rock with tongues

colour.base: Black/dark charcoal-grey base with yellow-white mineral veins; black melanoidin screens absorb and scatter excess UV at high altitude (F14, D23), while precipitated calcium and sulfur form surface veins.

journal.en: Black rock-skin. Eats sun, spits minerals. Safe only for scrapers.
journal.es: Piel negra de roca. Come sol, escupe minerales. Solo segura para raspadores.

secrets: Scraping deep reveals a living pale-green photosynthetic layer beneath the dead black crust
